WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval,
    SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scancount,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY si.healtheval
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_minute) OVER () AS mean_status_average
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT
  healtheval,
  total_scancount,
  avg_gb_per_scan_minute,
  avg_gb_per_scan_minute - mean_status_average AS gap_from_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_status_average IS NOT NULL;
